subject: vision worker readiness is a measured lifecycle contract
defects_closed: the vision listener marked every action=init message successful, including the worker's explicit status=error model-load reply
worker heartbeat, process existence, model initialization, IPC availability, listener liveness, and committed model-lane authority were collapsed into one implicit readiness assumption
a worker that exited during initialization could consume the full 30-second timeout and replace a specific load failure with an opaque timeout
inference trusted start_async's boolean without rechecking the serving contract immediately before queueing a request
camera control responses exposed capture transport but not whether the model that interprets a frame was actually ready
the touched privacy route carried three pre-existing Ruff violations, including its voice-chunk limit

implementation.init_protocol: only status ok or success may satisfy an init acknowledgement; error, missing, and unknown statuses become named init failures
implementation.liveness: local heartbeat receipt time and count are measured independently and never promoted to model initialization
implementation.failure_specificity: process exit receives a bounded 500ms listener grace so the worker's concrete init error wins over a generic exit reason
implementation.serving_guard: see_async rechecks the complete readiness receipt after startup and before dispatch
implementation.control_plane: camera privacy state and application receipts expose the bounded worker status without loading a model or opening a camera

verification.live_model_load: deferred while the resident-32B proof campaign owns the model lane

claim_boundary.reason: the lifecycle and negative cases are bounded-proven; a rebuilt app must still load the real vision checkpoint and return a valid frame interpretation after the 32B campaign releases the host
